description: This file defines the VSCodeCommitMessageAdapter class, which implements commit message generation and repository detection within a VSCode extension context. It interacts with VSCode APIs, manages progress reporting, and handles commit message creation logic.

classes.name: VSCodeCommitMessageAdapter
classes.description: A class that adapts commit message generation for VSCode, handling repository detection, progress reporting, and message handling.

methods.name: generateCommitMessage
methods.description: Generates a commit message asynchronously, managing progress reporting and error handling.

methods.name: determineTargetRepository
methods.description: Determines the appropriate Git repository based on the workspace path, activating the Git extension if necessary.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources by resetting the target repository reference.
